annotations.title: List what the AI receptionist did

description: Lists what the AI receptionist did and proposed for customers, newest first, one page at a time: each action’s capability, its state (done, failed, waiting for the customer’s Confirm tap, expired, and so on), whether it was a test from Try it, and the line the customer was shown. Lookups (what the AI read to answer, such as free times) are left out unless asked. A line can quote a booking’s or an order’s own words, and comes back marked untrusted. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

capability.description: Only the actions of this capability: booking, crm, payments or orders.

connection_id.description: Only the actions on this WhatsApp number.

conversation_id.description: Only the actions in this conversation.

include_lookups.description: true to list the lookups too. Lookups: what the AI read to answer, such as free times; left out unless asked.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

state.description: Only actions in this state: done, failed, checking, awaiting_send (an order or booking waiting for a person to check it and send it), awaiting_customer, awaiting_owner, executing, cancelled, expired, superseded or undone.

test.description: true for the test actions from Try it only, false for the rest.

name: list_receptionist_actions
title: List what the AI receptionist did
